Method of Attack: Identifies the user's NetBeans directory and enumerates all projects
Embeds a malicious payload in project files and build JAR files
Ensures persistence by executing the payload every time a NetBeans project is built
Drops payload and command and control software components into JAR files of other applications
Impacted Systems: Java applications built using infected NetBeans installations
Attack Vector: Supply chain attack targeting NetBeans IDE
Propagation through build artifacts of infected projects
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious payload embedded in project files and build JAR files
Command and control software components dropped into JAR files
